0022600127.text: The Nuggets host the Warriors in Denver's third game of the season, with Denver at 1-1 (1-0 at home, 0-1 on the road) and fourth in the Northwest, one game back, while Golden State is 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak in 15th place in the West. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, after the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, and the most recent meeting was a 116-93 Nuggets win in Denver on March 29, 2026. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Gui Santos (undisclosed), and Stephen Curry (rest) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
